Quarterly operations report, section 4.

Costs this quarter: ₹8,00,120.

When quoting a figure from the material, keep its exact digits and digit grouping. When restating a figure in different units or a different grouping convention, state the exact conversion being applied and verify the restated figure has the same value; never give two versions of one figure that have different values.

chat.answer:
**₹1,234,567**

- Source figure: ₹12,34,567 (Indian/lakh grouping: 12 | 34 | 567 → "12 lakh, 34 thousand, 567")
- Conversion applied: re-group the same seven digits in threes from the right — 1 | 234 | 567. No unit change, no rounding; the ₹ symbol and digit set are unchanged.
- Value check: 12×100,000 + 34×1,000 + 567 = 1,200,000 + 34,000 + 567 = **1,234,567**, identical to 1×1,000,000 + 234×1,000 + 567. Same value, different grouping.

(For context only, not part of the restatement: the costs line ₹8,00,120 would read ₹800,120 under the same re-grouping.)
